cards.key: Austin Reaves and Quentin Grimes are out, so Collin Sexton and Ziaire Williams should play more than usual.
Bilal Coulibaly and Justin Champagnie are out, so Alex Sarr and Kyshawn George should play more than usual.
Moussa Diabate and Dennis Schroder are out, so Hannes Steinbach and Coby White and Liam McNeeley should play more than usual.
Scottie Barnes and Immanuel Quickley are out, so Jakob Poeltl and Jamal Shead should play more than usual.
Tyrese Haliburton is out, so Quenton Jackson and Larry Nance and Andrew Nembhard should play more than usual.
Nikola Jokic has the top projection in this game at 53.6 DK points.
Devin Vassell is out, so Keldon Johnson should play more than usual.
Zion Williamson and Trey Murphy III are out, so Herbert Jones and Derik Queen and Dejounte Murray should play more than usual.

outs.note: Scottie Barnes was questionable for Nov. 9 against Memphis and appeared in the show's early optimal lineup despite the uncertainty. The show said that if Barnes and Quickley both play, RJ Barrett looks worse but still good.

Quickley missed Toronto's Nov. 6 game and the show said he is questionable for Nov. 9 against Memphis after a limited practice on Sunday. The show said it would rather play Quickley than Dylan Harper or De'Aaron Fox if he is active.
Leonard has not played since October 23. The show said it does not know whether he will be back in week 4.
The show said Yves Missi remains out for New Orleans on Monday. He has not played since October 23.

The show said Moussa Diabate is officially questionable for Monday. He missed Charlotte's game on November 6. If he sits, the show named Hannes Steinbach as the stream, since Steinbach played 27 minutes with 11 rebounds and three blocks in that game.
The show said Dennis Schroder is out at least two weeks. That removes a bench guard from the Charlotte rotation.

The show said Brandon Miller is out for Monday's game with a hip strain and that no long-term timeline has been announced. He played only 14 minutes in his last game on November 6. Charlotte is running very thin on healthy players.

Quentin Grimes started for the resting Luka Doncic on Nov 8 and had 12 points and 4 assists in 32 minutes. He hurt his finger late, did not return, and had negative X-rays, so the show said there is some doubt he plays on Nov 9. The show said he does little when Doncic plays.
